normalization: One trade maximum per assigned market; valid no-signal windows zero; missing data separate.
collection: Existing public order-book and Chainlink recorders. This file freezes the rule; it does not start a new decision writer.
baseline: favorite at the same time and same eligible windows
success: >=3 separate days, >=100 eligible windows AND >=100 selected trades; both day/window clustered lower CI>0, excluding top3 positive. All failed and missing windows reported; no parameter updates during the period.
